website.description: The only combo plugin you'll ever need!
website.readmeExcerpt:
What does it do? This!


Features

Ultimate Combo is based off of several combo plugins, but has completely new logic, features, and many quality of life improvements.
The following are just a few of said features: * Fresh, custom, and smooth PvE combo logic, updated for Dawntrail, for all classes * Intuitive UI * Better controller support * Blue Mage combos for all mimicries * Occult Crescent / Variant / Bozja / Eureka logic * Crazy overpowered PvP combos

Installation

You must have XIVLauncher/Dalamud installed. Ultimate Combo is not guaranteed to work with other combo plugins. Installing multiple combo plugins may produce unexpected results. Ultimate Combo pairs very well with the following plugins: * ReAction, for automatic target picking and turbo mode * BossMod Reborn, for lag reduction * Avarice, for positional tells * Orbwalker, for slidecasting

You can find installation instructions for the above plugins on their github pages.

For recommended settings for each plugin, check the #recommended-settings channel in the Discord


Steps: * Copy the following repository link:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StackBLU/UltimateCombo/main/pluginmaster.json` * Type `/xlsettings` in the game chat window to open the Dalamud Settings window * Navigate to the "Experimental" tab * Paste the link you copied into the next available input box under "Custom Plugin Repositories" * Ensure the "Enabled" box to the right is checked * Press "Save and Close" at the bottom of the settings window * Navigate to the "All Plugins" tab and search for "Ultimate Combo" * Click on "Ultimate Combo" and select "Install"

If you experience any bugs or errors, please create an issue here on github, or join the Discord

Commands

| **Commands**                               | **Function** | | :-- | :-- | | `/uc`| Opens the main plugin window, where you can enable and disable options| | `/uc enable `| Turns a specific option on by referring to its internal name| | `/uc disable `| Turns a specific option off by referring to its internal name| | `/uc toggle `| Toggles a specific option by referring to its internal name| | `/uc enableall`| Turns all options on| | `/uc disableall`| Turns all options off| | `/uc gcd`| Toggles the GCD Counting setting| | `/uc enabled`| Prints a list of every enabled option into the game chat| | `/uc debug`| Outputs a full debug file to your desktop that can be sent to developers to assist in bug fixing| | `/uc debug `| Outputs a debug file to your desktop containing only job-relevant options|


Developed by:
